def balloon_bonus_factor(N, balloons):
    filled_percentages = [0] * N
    bonus_factors = [1] * N

    for i, (x, p) in enumerate(balloons):
        if p > x:
            continue

        if i == 0 or x > balloons[i - 1][0]:
            bonus_factors[i] = 1
        else:
            min_x = min(balloons[j][0] for j in range(i))
            bonus_factors[i] = 1 / (1 + (x - min_x) / p)

        filled_percentages[i] = min(1, (i + 1) * 1.0 / N)

        if filled_percentages[i] < 1:
            for j in range(i + 1, N):
                if j == N - 1 or x > balloons[j][0]:
                    break
                bonus_factors[j] = 1 / (1 + (x - balloons[j][0]) / balloons[j][1])

    return sum(filled_percentages[i] * bonus_factors[i] for i in range(N))
